items.name: False scarcity or fake urgency
items.reason: It can increase pressure and reactance, and it violates the project's low-pressure sales boundary.

items.name: Hidden emotion diagnosis
items.reason: Emotion signals are weak context; hidden-state certainty is already blocked by existing project policy.

items.name: Commitment traps
items.reason: Turning a soft yes into obligation conflicts with autonomy, trust, and no-commitment relief.

items.name: Full customer-category echoing
items.reason: Repeating boss, spouse, manager, or partner every time sounds scripted and does not add useful listening evidence.

items.name: Large live psychology planner
items.reason: A heavy reasoning layer can add latency. Research should be compressed into deterministic, reviewed rules first.

items.name: General persuasion principles without source mapping
items.reason: Generic tricks such as reciprocity, liking, and social proof are too easy to misuse unless tied to a safe, source-backed response rule.
